compact/posix/claude-code/ollama-embed/o.copy:
# Keep generated configuration files out of version control.
echo .chunkhound.json >> .gitignore
# Configure ChunkHound with Ollama embeddings and OpenAI for research. Embedding and LLM providers are independent — either works without the other. Field details: https://chunkhound.ai/docs/configuration/
# You'll need: OpenAI API key
cat > .chunkhound.json <<'CHUNKHOUND_EOF'
{
  "embedding": {
    "provider": "openai",
    "model": "qwen3-embedding",
    "base_url": "http://localhost:11434/v1"
  },
  "llm": {
    "provider": "openai",
    "api_key": "<YOUR_OPENAI_API_KEY>"
  }
}
CHUNKHOUND_EOF
# Configure Claude Code to connect to ChunkHound via MCP.
claude mcp add ChunkHound -- chunkhound mcp
# Build ChunkHound's search index for this project.
chunkhound index .
